wire.voice.title: Voice mode
wire.voice.description: Talk to one conversation at a time with push-to-talk. That conversation's own agent answers, and its last reply is read aloud. Read on the next spoken reply.
wire.voice.max_spoken_chars.label: longest spoken reply
wire.voice.max_spoken_chars.help: Replies longer than this many characters are cut at a sentence and end with "The rest is on screen." Code blocks and links are never read aloud.
wire.voice.not_enabled: Voice mode is not on for this conversation. Turn it on for this conversation first.
wire.voice.unknown_session: There is no conversation with id {session_id}.
wire.voice.unknown_source: There is nothing to read aloud for that reference.
wire.voice.stt_unavailable: This device cannot transcribe speech: {reason} Type the message instead.
wire.voice.invalid_request: Send exactly one of a recording or a text message, not both and not neither.
wire.voice.unsupported_audio: That recording format is not supported. Use WAV, WebM, Ogg or MP4.
wire.voice.upload_too_large: That recording is too large. Keep it under {limit_mib} MiB.
wire.voice.empty_transcript: Nothing was heard in that recording, so nothing was sent.
wire.voice.store_busy: Something else on this device is changing voice mode. Try again in a moment.
wire.voice.invalid_request_id: The request id must be a dashed UUID, so nothing was sent.
wire.voice.approval_pending: Answer the question or approval on screen first.
